	const screenWidth = window.screen.width;

	const width = Math.round(screenWidth * 0.8);
	const height = Math.round(screenHeight * 0.8);

	const left = (screenWidth - width) / 2;

const getClock = () => {
	const setClock = () => {
		/* 요일명 */
		let week = new Array("(일)", "(월)", "(화)", "(수)", "(목)", "(금)", "(토)")
		/* 현재 날짜 */
		let today = new Date();
		/* AM,PM */
		let ampm = today.getHours() < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"
		/* 년 */
		let year = today.getFullYear();
		/* 월 */
		let month = ('0' + (today.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2);
		/* 일 */
		let day = ('0' + today.getDate()).slice(-2);
		/* 요일 */
		let dayName = week[today.getDay()];
		/* 시*/
		let hours = ('0' + today.getHours()).slice(-2);
		/* 분*/
		let min = ('0' + today.getMinutes()).slice(-2);
		/* 초 */
		let sec = ('0' + today.getSeconds()).slice(-2);

		let date = `${year}년 ${month}월 ${day}일${dayName}`;
		let time = `${hours}:${min}:${sec}`;

		$("#dateClock").text(date);
		$("#clock").text(time);
	}

	setClock();
	setInterval(setClock, 1000);
}
</script>

	function LPAD(s, c, n) {
		if (! s || ! c || s.length >= n) {
			return s;
		}
		var max = (n - s.length)/c.length;

			s = c + s;
		}
		return s;
	}
